cases.title: Natural trips (6 seeds): 776 samples, 11 sensors AVAILABLE and physically plausible, 0 rule events, 200 ms axis
cases.input: SimulationSource NORMAL default length through Session + SQLite

cases.title: Every sensor changes over the trip (stored readings come from the simulator, not constants)
cases.input: count distinct stored values per sensor over 776 samples
cases.expected: >= 5 distinct values for every sensor except possibly trims

cases.title: Long simulation (600 s and 900 s) keeps driving: no engine stop, continuous time axis, no false events
cases.expected: 3001/4501 samples, RPM > 500 after 45 s, speed still varies after 150 s, 0 events

cases.title: Default 155 s trip unchanged by the long-run fix (776 samples ending at 155.0 s)
Seven single faults (60 s, 35 s) each raise their own rule event
cases.actual: S01->['MS_THERMAL']; S02->['MS_AIR_FUEL']; S03->['MS_FUEL_RESPONSE']; S04->['MS_AIRFLOW']; S05->['MS_SUPPLY']; S06->['MS_COMBUSTION']; S07->['MS_SIGNAL']

cases.title: Simultaneous faults keep every event (S04+S07 included)
cases.input: six pairs injected at 60 s for 35 s
cases.expected: both expected kinds for every injectable pair (masking fixed); non-injectable pairs reported
cases.actual: {"S04+S07": ["MS_AIRFLOW", "MS_SIGNAL"], "S01+S05": ["MS_SUPPLY", "MS_THERMAL"], "S02+S06": "not injectable: Conflicting scenario writes: S02, S06", "S03+S05": "not injectable: Conflicting scenario writes: S03, S05", "S01+S07": ["MS_SIGNAL", "MS_THERMAL"], "S02+S07": "not injectable: Conflicting scenario writes: S02, S07"}
cases.notes: Pairs rejected by the simulator are not counted as failures; they conflict on the sensors they write (documented in DC-FIX-001).
